# More Power to the Grid

Long-duration energy storage at scale. Cost-competitive, reliable, deployed globally.

[Discover More](https://energydome.com/our-solutions/)

- ![](https://energydome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Homepage-images-circles2.png)











## Welcome to the World of Modern Energy











We are giving people everywhere better access to energy by modernizing the grid with a unique, cost-competitive solution. Energy Dome’s CO2 Battery is a long-duration energy storage technology that delivers clean power without a premium. Designed for rapid deployment, it strengthens grids, stabilises energy prices, and provides the reliable capacity needed for resilience, security, and independence. Modern energy is already here.













[LET’S START](https://energydome.com/our-solutions/)


- ![](https://energydome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Homepage-image_TES.png)











## LDES. Made Easy.











The CO2 Battery is now being deployed globally, making energy storage as competitive, flexible, and reliable as conventional generation. Our solution is modular, scalable, and built with proven, sustainable materials such as steel and CO2. It’s the only LDES technology that makes sense in the marketplace today, delivering modern, sustainable energy at scale.











  - Flexible capacity

  - Cost-competitive

  - Reliable

  - Grid-ready in under two years

  - Modular, scalable and bankable

  - Off-the-shelf components

  - 30+ year lifetime with no performance degradation


[LEARN MORE](https://energydome.com/co2-battery/)

### Who knew that CO2 could be the solution?

**That’s right, we use carbon dioxide to create a new world of energy.**

Energy Dome’s technology operates through a thermo-mechanical cycle, charging by drawing carbon dioxide from a ‘Dome’ gasholder, storing it under pressure, and then dispatching it by evaporating and expanding the gas through a turbine back into the gasholder.

[LEARN MORE](https://energydome.com/co2-battery/)

## There are two ways to join the   world of Modern energy storage

Not all the energy storage needs are the same. Not all the objectives are the same. That’s why we provide two different solutions.

- ![](https://energydome.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/feature_graph-e1707992711823-918x673.jpeg)











## Energy Storage As a Service





You buy only the storage capacity you need, and we’ll take care of the rest.







[LEARN MORE](https://energydome.com/our-solutions/energy-storage-as-a-service/)


- ![](https://energydome.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/compressor_modified-918x516-1.png)











## Buy Your Own Plant





For those who want full ownership and control, we supply you with our CO2 Battery. But don’t worry, we’ve got your back, as we’ll be there for you every step of the way.
